question: What is a white dwarf star?
short_answer: A white dwarf is the dense stellar remnant core left behind when a low to medium mass star (like our Sun) exhausts its nuclear fusion fuel.
full_explanation: Supported against collapse by quantum electron degeneracy pressure, a white dwarf packs the mass of the Sun into an object the size of Earth.
